capabilities.title: REST API for vault sync: encrypted items, folders, collections, and org sharing
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Bitwarden server: complete vault API for all official clients
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a password vault server. Bitwarden server API is outside product scope.

capabilities.title: Bitwarden Send: end-to-end encrypted file and text sharing with expiration
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Bitwarden Send: ephemeral encrypted sharing links
capabilities.reason: Nexus has no authenticated recipient, key-distribution, revocation, or expiry service. A partial sharing-link implementation would create a false confidentiality boundary for private artifacts.

capabilities.title: Event log API: structured audit trail for all vault operations
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Bitwarden server event log: structured JSONL per-action audit
capabilities.reason: The sealed VAULT keeps bounded, content-free create, update, restore, delete, and re-key receipts inside its encrypted payload, while explicitly avoiding an immutable or server-wide audit claim.

capabilities.title: Per-seat SaaS licensing and billing for organizations
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Bitwarden server: license enforcement for organizations
capabilities.reason: Nexus is MIT-licensed and free; SaaS billing infrastructure is excluded by the product guarantee.
